### Definition of Ready (DoR)

<!--
Checklist items to ensure the proposal is ready for review.
-->

- [ ] Purpose and scope clearly defined
- [ ] Target file and action type specified
- [ ] Major changes listed (if refactor)
- [ ] Related issues linked
- [ ] Acceptance criteria listed
- [ ] Estimate added (if applicable)

### Definition of Done (DoD)

<!--
Checklist items to ensure the proposal is complete and actionable.
-->

- [ ] All acceptance criteria met and verified
- [ ] Changelog entry prepared for PR (CHANGELOG.md)
- [ ] Documentation updated (if needed)
- [ ] Instruction tested/validated
- [ ] PR uses correct branch prefix (instructions/)
- [ ] Approved by at least one maintainer
